paragraph: I had a fight with my older **brother** yesterday. Is it true that you have a **brother** in Germany? I'm three years older than my **brother**.
english: male sibling
arabicDesc: مثال: تشاجرت مع أخي الكبير البارحة.

paragraph: I couldn't **catch** on to the joke he told us. I always **catch** a cold in the winter. Where did you **catch** up with them?
english: to intercept an object in the air etc.
arabicDesc: مثال: لم أفهم الطرفة التي قصها علينا.

paragraph: I got my **foot** caught in a train door. He hurt his left **foot** when he fell. He went the whole way on **foot**.
english: part of human body
arabicDesc: مثال: علقت رجلي بباب القطار.

paragraph: This is the **main** thing I have learned. That was the **main** reason that I did that. That's the **main** reason I'll never do that again.
english: chief, most important, or principal in extent, etc.
arabicDesc: مثال: هذا هو الشيء الرئيسي الذي تعلمته.

paragraph: The old man fell down on the **ground**. I slept on the **ground**. One by one, the leaves fall to the **ground**.
english: surface of the Earth
arabicDesc: مثال: وقع الرجل العجوز على الأرض.

paragraph: We need to stay **focused**. We need to **focus** on our long-term goals. That's what we need to **focus** on doing first.
english: a point at which reflected or refracted rays of light converge
arabicDesc: مثال: يجب أن نبقى منتبهين.

paragraph: Where are you planning to go this **summer**? You promised me to come back before **summer**. It is hot in the **summer** and cold in the winter.
english: hottest season
arabicDesc: مثال: أين تخطط لذهاب في فصل الصيف.

paragraph: Unless you make a **decision** quickly, the opportunity will be lost. I'll leave the **decision** to you. The **decision** hasn't yet been made.
english: choice or judgement
arabicDesc: مثال: ستضيع الفرصة ما لم تتخذ قرارا بسرعة.

paragraph: You're my only source of **security** in this world. I have no other **security** in life but you. If you don't leave right now, I'll call **security**.
english: condition of not being threatened
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: أمان، سلامة

other.meaning: something that secures the fulfillment of an obligation

paragraph: Please make three copies of this **page**. Please go to the next **page**. Read the bottom of the **page**.
english: one side of a leaf of a book
arabicDesc: مثال: من فضلك، انسخ ثلاثة نسخ من هذه الصفحة.

paragraph: I have to comment on this **article**. I want to write an **article**. When did I write this **article**?
english: story, report, or opinion piece
arabicDesc: مثال: علي أن أعلق على ذلك المقال.

other.meaning: part of speech that specifies a noun

paragraph: I came to see **Dr**. King last year. Please connect me with **Dr**. White. Thank you very much, **dr**.
english: drive, used in street names

paragraph: **Instead** of going myself, I sent a letter. She will attend the meeting **instead** of me. **Instead** of going to Europe, I decided to go to America.
english: in the place of (it)
arabicDesc: مثال: بعثت برسالة بدلاً من الذهاب بنفسي.

paragraph: I'm the **king** of the world. Once upon a time, there was a **king** who had three beautiful daughters. There is no **King** on the Road of Death.
english: a male of a royal family who is the supreme ruler of his nation
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا ملك الدنيا.

paragraph: This land is my **property**. Everyone has the right to own **property** alone as well as in association with others. A child is not the **property** of his parents.
english: something owned
arabicDesc: مثال: هذه الأرض من أملاكي.

other.meaning: attribute or abstract quality associated with an object, individual or concept
an attribute characteristic of a class of objects

paragraph: He read this in the **press**. **Press** any key to continue. **Press** and wait for green.
english: to apply pressure
arabicDesc: مثال: قرأ هذا في الصحافة.

paragraph: I don't have the **energy** for this life anymore. I don't have any **energy** left. Dates give you more **energy**.
english: impetus behind activity
arabicDesc: مثال: لم يعد لدي القوة الكافية للعيش بعد الآن.

paragraph: School did not play any **role** in their lives. I think that we have a **role** to play. Be a good **role** model for those around you.
english: a character or part played by a performer or actor

paragraph: The teacher said that the earth is **round**. Thanks, I'm just having a look **round**. Did you buy a **round**-trip ticket?
english: of shape:
arabicDesc: مثال: قال المعلم ان الارض كروية.

other.meaning: A circular or spherical object or part of an object (noun)

paragraph: I thought this was **common** knowledge. We never had much in **common**, you and I. We have more in **common** than I first thought.
english: mutual
arabicDesc: مثال: ظننت هذا معلوما.

paragraph: We can't be sure of the **total** cost yet. What is the **total** price with all taxes included? There are a **total** of 197 countries in the world.
english: an amount obtained by the addition of smaller amounts

paragraph: He suggested we should stop smoking at the **meeting**. He won't be in time for the **meeting**. I'm going to be late for the **meeting**.
english: gathering for a purpose
arabicDesc: مثال: اقترحَ أن نتوقف عن التدخين أثناء الاجتماع.

other.meaning: action noun of the verb to meet

paragraph: Do you have a larger **size**? They make me believe I'm wearing the smallest **size**. We have your **size**, but not in that color.
english: dimensions or magnitude of a thing
arabicDesc: مثال: أهناك مقاس أكبر؟

paragraph: What he says does not make any **sense**. I really think that we, women, have an extra **sense**. What she said did not make **sense**.
english: meaning or reason
arabicDesc: مثال: ما يقوله ليس له أي معنى.

other.meaning: manner by which living beings perceive the physical world

paragraph: The **director** wants to see you. He became a film **director**. She slept with her **director**.
english: supervisor, manager — see also film director
arabicDesc: مثال: المديرة تريد رؤيتك.

paragraph: Both **sexes** defend the nesting site, although most defense is done by the male. Tom and Mary thought their marriage would be more interesting if they both changed **sexes**.
english: a category into which sexually-reproducing organisms are divided on the basis of their reproductive roles in their species

other.meaning: act of sexual intercourse — see also rumpy-pumpy

paragraph: Switch off the light. I can't get to **sleep**. How many hours of **sleep** do you need? He thinks that you need to **sleep** more.
english: to rest in state of reduced consciousness
arabicDesc: مثال: أطفئ الضوء. لا يمكنني النوم.

other.meaning: The state of reduced consciousness during which a human or animal rests in a daily rhythm (noun)

paragraph: Please leave a **comment** below. There are no **comments** for now. I can't understand those **comments**.
english: spoken remark
arabicDesc: مثال: من فضلك، اترك تعليقا أدناه.

paragraph: I left my **card** at home. Can I pay by credit **card**? Please give me your credit **card**.
english: flat, normally rectangular piece of stiff paper, plastic etc.
arabicDesc: مثال: تركت بطاقتي في المنزل.

paragraph: I saw a man coming **toward** me. He ran **toward** me as fast as he could. The boy ran and ran **toward** the goal.
english: in the direction of
arabicDesc: مثال: رأيت رجلاً يتّجه نحوي.

paragraph: The **organization** helps the poor. She is playing an important role in our **organization**. The **organization** of the text has value in writing.
english: group of people or other legal entities with an explicit purpose and written rules
arabicDesc: مثال: المنظمة تساعد الفقراء.

paragraph: I thought you had higher **standards**. You hold yourself to a higher **standard** than that. We take our high **standard** of living for granted.
english: falling within an accepted range of size, amount, power, quality, etc
arabicDesc: مثال: ظننتك تملك معايير أسمى.

other.meaning: A principle or example or measure used for comparison (noun)

paragraph: I **practice** sport almost every day. In theory, there is no difference between theory and **practice**. But, in **practice**, there is. I've never seen anything like this in my **practice**.
english: repetition of an activity to improve skill
arabicDesc: مثال: امارس الرياضة كل يوم تقريبا

paragraph: How many people are there in the **store**? Will you come with me to the **store**? You never can tell what you might find at that **store**.
english: keep (something) while not in use
arabicDesc: مثال: كم شخصاً يوجد في المتجر؟

paragraph: Do you want to go out for a **drink**? Do you have the time to **drink** something? And we gave it to you to **drink**.
english: consume liquid through the mouth
arabicDesc: مثال: أتريد الخروج لاحتساء شيء؟

paragraph: Are you **related** to him? You find it hard to **relate** to women. I really **relate** to the main character in this movie.
english: to be connected with something; also to tell a story
arabicDesc: مثال: هل أنت قريبه؟

paragraph: He told me he was going to **America**. What is the most popular sport in **America**? She left for **America** the day before yesterday.
english: the United States; also the continents of North and South America
arabicDesc: مثال: أخبرني أنه ذاهب إلى أمريكا.

paragraph: This flower is the most **beautiful** of all flowers. A **beautiful** object like that never loses its value. There are a lot of **beautiful** buildings in this town.
english: attractive
arabicDesc: مثال: هذه الوردة هي أجمل الورود على الإطلاق.

paragraph: My mother **hates** writing letters. I'm not one of those men who **hates** women. Life is too short to waste time **hating** anyone.
english: to dislike intensely
arabicDesc: مثال: تكره أمي كتابة الرسائل.

paragraph: There is little hope of his winning the **election**. Does he have a chance in winning the **election**? Their party won the most votes in the **election**.
english: process of choosing a new leader or representatives by popular vote
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: انتخابات

paragraph: What is the total **amount** of money you spent? This is the **amount** that you need to pay. The **amount** I was paid was less than expected.
english: the total, aggregate or sum of material (not applicable to discrete numbers or units or items in standard English)
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مقدار

paragraph: Do you like to **travel** by yourself? We had to **travel** on a bus. He likes to **travel** by himself.
english: be on a journey
arabicDesc: مثال: أتحب السفر بمفردك؟

other.meaning: pass from here to there; transmit

paragraph: An **individual** is the smallest unit of the society. Not one **individual** has failed to seek you out. The old doctor gave **individual** attention to each patient.
english: a person considered alone, rather than as belonging to a group of people
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: شخص

paragraph: This car has a better **performance** than that one. I don't think that his **performance** was any good. I am happy with the **performance** of my team.
english: the act of performing; carrying into execution or action; accomplishment
arabicDesc: مثال: أداء هذه السيارة أفضل من تلك.

paragraph: Which goes faster, a **ship** or a train? We return to the **ship**. I work for a **shipping** company.
english: large water craft
arabicDesc: مثال: أيهما أسرع، السفينة أم القطار؟

paragraph: You can take away my **title** if you want. I will now give you the **title** of king. Only at the end does one understand the **title**.
english: the name of a film, musical piece, painting, or other work of art

paragraph: There may be a **range** of opinions between us. I have a wide **range** of interests in life. Don't you have something in my price **range**?
english: a line or series of mountains, buildings, etc
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: قدرة

paragraph: The next **stage** was to enter a good arts school. Before long she will come back to the **stage**. The world is a **stage** and life a play.
english: a phase
arabicDesc: مثال: كانت المرحلة التالية هي الدخول إلى مدرسة للفنون.

paragraph: I met a friend of **mine** at the airport. I would like you to meet a friend of **mine**. His house is three times larger than **mine**.
english: that which belongs to me
arabicDesc: مثال: التقيتُ بصديق لي في المطار.

other.meaning: An excavation from which ore or solid minerals are taken, especially one consisting of underground tunnels (noun)
To remove (rock or ore) from the ground (verb)

paragraph: There is a **church** near my house. His parents go to **church** every Sunday. We went to the same **church**.
english: house of worship
arabicDesc: مثال: هناك كنيسة بالقرب من منزلي.

paragraph: I **guess** you know who I am talking about. I **guess** we can't say no. Can you **guess** what I have?
english: to reach an unconfirmed conclusion
arabicDesc: مثال: أظن أنك تعلم عن من أتحدث.

paragraph: Try to **raise** your status at work. You **raised** me, didn't you? If you have a thought, please **raise** your hand.
english: to cause to rise
arabicDesc: مثال: حاول ترقية منصبك في العمل.

paragraph: How many episodes of One **Piece** have you watched? I'll give you a good **piece** of advice. He gave her a **piece** of advice.
english: part of a larger whole
arabicDesc: مثال: كم من حلقة من وان بيس شاهدت؟

paragraph: This is a woman who we can **trust**. She didn't know who she could **trust**. I need you to **trust** me.
english: confidence in or reliance on some person or quality
arabicDesc: مثال: يمكننا الإعتماد على هذه المرأة.

other.meaning: a group of businessmen or traders
To place confidence in, to rely on, to confide in (verb)

paragraph: I should have kept my **cool**. She was a **cool** teacher. You will never be as **cool** as I am.
english: of a mildly low temperature
arabicDesc: مثال: كان على أن أبقى هادئ.

other.meaning: To lose heat, to get colder (verb)

paragraph: They don't seem to feel **especially** at home here. The traffic is heavy here, **especially** in the morning. Children need love, **especially** when they don't deserve it.
english: particularly
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: خصوصا، ولا سيما

paragraph: My daughter is getting married in **June**. I hope to be able to go in **June**. During the first days of **June**, it was hot.
english: sixth month of the Gregorian calendar
arabicDesc: مثال: ستتزوج ابنتي في يونيو

paragraph: I had a problem **similar** to that not too long ago. They look so **similar** that I don't know who is who. Your problem is **similar** to mine.
english: having traits or characteristics in common; alike, comparable
arabicDesc: مثال: واجهت مشكلا مماثلا مؤخرا.

paragraph: What's the **average** age of students in this class? Stop thinking of me as just an **average** person. He is a cut above the **average** college student.
english: any measure of central tendency, especially any mean, the median, or the mode

other.meaning: Constituting or relating to the average (adjective)

paragraph: Where did you **beat** them up? You **beat** them, didn't you? Why are you **beating** my mother?!
english: to hit, to knock, to pound, to strike
arabicDesc: مثال: أين ضربتهم؟

paragraph: This matter does not **concern** me. What does it **concern** you? This is **concerning** to me.
english: to relate to or be of importance to
arabicDesc: مثال: هذا الأمر لا يعنيني.

paragraph: He's not **perfect**, but I love him anyway. I'm in a **perfect** world. It was a **perfect** morning.
english: fitting its definition precisely
arabicDesc: مثال: ليس شخصًا مثاليًا، ولكن مع ذلك أحبه.

paragraph: I took that **photo** a week ago. Is this a recent **photo**? Could you take some **photos** of your city for me?
english: a picture taken with a camera
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا أخذت تلك الصورة قبل إسبوع.

paragraph: Her hair **style** makes her look younger than her age. Compare the **style** of those letters. These girls don't really seem to be your **style**.
english: senses relating to a thin, pointed object
arabicDesc: مثال: تصفيفة شعرها تجعلها تبدو أصغر من عمرها.

paragraph: The **score** is one all. What was the final **score**? She is not in the least worried about her test **scores**.
english: the total number of goals, points, runs, etc. earned by a participant in a game
arabicDesc: مثال: النتيجة واحد الكلّ.

other.meaning: performance of an individual or group on an examination or test

paragraph: Let go of my **arm**. You're hurting me. He had a big box in his **arms**. She has long **arms** and legs.
english: upper appendage from shoulder to wrist
arabicDesc: مثال: اترك ذراعي. أنت تؤلمني.

other.meaning: To supply with armour or (later especially) weapons (verb)

paragraph: **Society** has seen a lot of change recently. We live in a **society**. If women aren't free, **society** will never be free.
english: group of people sharing culture
arabicDesc: مثال: طرأت كثير من التغيرات على المجتمع مؤخرًا.

other.meaning: group of persons who meet from time to time to engage in a common interest
people of one’s country or community as a whole

paragraph: I've got the feeling you're on the wrong **track**. I've been trying to **track** you down all morning. The government doesn't want to **track** numbers like these.
english: a mark left by something that has passed along

other.meaning: path or course laid out for a race or exercise

paragraph: You will **explain** to me how it's done, won't you? Can you **explain** what you actually want? How do I **explain** that to him?
english: to make intelligible
arabicDesc: مثال: ستفسر لي كيف يقومون بهذا، أليس كذلك؟

paragraph: I think love does not **exist**. Life can't **exist** without water. Your sentence was not added because the following already **exists**.
english: to be
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا أعتقد أن الحب غير موجود.

paragraph: Those who live in glass houses shouldn't **throw** stones. Where did you **throw** them away? Have you ever **thrown** up in a bus?
english: to cause an object to move rapidly through the air
arabicDesc: مثال: لا ترمي الناس بالحجارة وبيتك من زجاج.

paragraph: **Above** all, don't forget to write me. I love this book **above** all. **Above** all, children need love.
english: in or to a higher place
arabicDesc: مثال: والأهم، لا تنسى أن تكتب لي.

paragraph: I'm not **likely** to forget to do that. He is **likely** to arrive soon. They're **likely** to forget their promises.
english: probable
arabicDesc: مثال: من الأرجح أنّني لن أنس ذلك.

paragraph: The use of **military** force is not being considered. The two men were tried by a **military** court. Not far from the house was a **military** hospital.
english: characteristic of members of the armed forces

paragraph: She didn't want to know anything about his **personal** life. I want a **personal** computer. That's just a **personal** opinion.
english: of or pertaining to a particular person
arabicDesc: مثال: لم تكن ترغب في معرفة أي شيئ عن حياته الشخصية.

paragraph: She put down her thoughts on **paper**. I have to write a letter. Do you have some **paper**? How much **paper** do we need?
english: sheet material
arabicDesc: مثال: دونت ما تفكر به على الورق.

other.meaning: written document shorter than a book — see also article

paragraph: It's going to be quite **hot** today. Make sure the water isn't too **hot**. It isn't as **hot** here as I expected it to be.
english: of the weather
arabicDesc: مثال: سيكون اليوم حار جداً

paragraph: The machine is now in **operation**. I want you to take charge of this **operation**. It is her second **operation** already in one year.
english: method by which a device performs its function
arabicDesc: مثال: الآلة الآن تعمل.

other.meaning: procedure for generating a value from one or more other values

paragraph: I found the **key** that I was looking for. Is this the **key** you were looking for? Have you lost the **key** of your house?
english: device designed to open and close a lock
arabicDesc: مثال: وجت المفتاح الذي كنت أبحث عنه.

other.meaning: button on a typewriter or computer keyboard

paragraph: Do you want the green or the **blue**? This young man has **blue** hair. Which one do you prefer, the red one or the **blue** one?
english: blue-coloured — see also dark blue, light blue
arabicDesc: مثال: أتريد الاخضر أو الازرق؟

other.meaning: The colour of the clear sky or the deep sea (noun)

paragraph: He has **published** many papers on the subject. I haven't had the time these days to **publish** it. I was forced to self-**publish** my book.
english: to issue something (usually printed work) for sale and distribution
arabicDesc: مثال: نشر العديد من الأوراق حول هذا الموضوع.

paragraph: I do not like **science**. This is the **science** teacher. He was our **science** teacher.
english: particular discipline or branch of learning
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أحب مادة العلوم.

paragraph: Once, I got lost **inside** a tree. Let's go **inside**. It's cold out here. Would you like to come **inside**?
english: interior or inner part
arabicDesc: مثال: مرّةً، ضِعتُ داخل شجرة.

other.meaning: Within or towards the interior of something (adverb)
Within the interior of, closest to the center or to a specific point of reference (preposition)

paragraph: I'll **teach** you how to drive a car. I'm going to **teach** you how to fish next Sunday. I'll be happy to **teach** you things.
english: to pass on knowledge
arabicDesc: مثال: سأعلمك القيادة.

paragraph: Maybe you want to talk in **private**. Can I have a **private** opinion? Are you a student of a **private** high school?
english: belonging to, concerning, or accessible only to an individual person or a specific group
arabicDesc: مثال: أتريد التّحدّث على انفراد؟

other.meaning: A soldier of the lowest rank in the army (noun)

paragraph: You must **realize** that I can't help you. I never **realized** he loved me. You **realize** what we have to do, don't you?
english: (''transitive'') to become aware of or understand (a fact or situation)
arabicDesc: مثال: يجب أن تدرك بأننا لن نستطيع تقديم يد العون.

other.meaning: to convert (something imaginary or planned) into reality; to make real

paragraph: **Sport** is good for your health. He doesn't like any **sport**. Winter **sports** are very popular in our country.
english: any athletic activity that uses physical skills
arabicDesc: مثال: الرياضة جيدة لصحتك.

other.meaning: person who exhibits either good or bad sportsmanship
somebody who behaves or reacts in an admirable manner

paragraph: I don't have enough time to explain that to you in **detail**. I would like to discuss a few **details**. He wrote down all the **details**.
english: part small enough to escape casual notice
arabicDesc: مثال: ليس لديّ الوقت الكافي كي أفسّر لك هذا بالتّفصيل.

paragraph: She was born on **April** 4, 1940. We'll have lived here for two years next **April**. This story took place in **April** of last year.
english: fourth month of the Gregorian calendar
arabicDesc: مثال: ولدت يوم 4 أفريل 1940.

paragraph: The plant in the kitchen is **dead** because I forgot to water it.
english: no longer alive

paragraph: Does this letter have to be written in **English**? **English** is not easy, but it is interesting. About how many **English** words do you know?
english: of or pertaining to the English language
arabicDesc: مثال: هل يجب ان تُكتْب هذه الرسالة بالإنجليزية

other.meaning: The people of England, e.g., Englishmen and Englishwomen (noun)
A variety, dialect, or idiolect of spoken and or written English (noun)

paragraph: He owns an **online** store. Are you making money **online**? How much time do you spend **online** every day?
english: connected to or done on the internet
arabicDesc: مثال: هو يملك متجرا إلكترونيا.

paragraph: I don't remember if I locked the back **door**. When was the last time you locked this **door**? Did you forget to lock the **door** last night?
english: portal of entry into a building, room or vehicle
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أذكر إن أقفلت الباب الخلفي أم لا.

paragraph: It's like I was talking to a **wall**. There is a picture on the **wall**. You never listen. I might as well talk to the **wall**.
english: defensive rampart
arabicDesc: مثال: وكأنني كنت أحدث الحائط.

other.meaning: structure built for defense surrounding an area
substantial structure acting as side or division in a building

paragraph: Try to establish yourself as a **leader**. Take me to your **leader**. They all looked up to him as their **leader**.
english: one having authority
arabicDesc: مثال: حاول أن تصبح زعيما.

paragraph: Are you ready for the speaking **activity** in class? This is a fun **activity** for the whole family. We know everything about your **activity** at this location.
english: state or quality of being active

paragraph: We decided to **enter** the room. I saw her **enter** the room. When I **entered** his room, he was reading a book.
english: to go into (a room, etc.)
arabicDesc: مثال: قررنا الدخول إلى تلك الغرفة.

paragraph: What do you **suggest** that we do now? I **suggest** we go out for a drink. Can you **suggest** a better idea?
english: to ask for without demanding
arabicDesc: مثال: ماذا تقترحْ أن نفعل الآن؟
